description: Every webhook HorseToga has sent (or tried to send) for your key, newest job first: job.started, job.completed / job.failed and usage.threshold. Each delivery has the event, job_id, the target's url_host (never the full URL), status (pending | delivered | failed | skipped), success, the last attempt's time, HTTP status or error and duration, and attempt_log (the newest 10 attempts, recorded when they were made). 20 per page (limit 1-100); next_cursor is null on the last page. Covers the key's newest 2,000 jobs. Read-only and free. The same as GET /api/v1/webhooks/deliveries.

api_key.description: Your HorseToga API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

cursor.description: Opaque: pass next_cursor from the previous page to get the next one.

limit.description: How many deliveries per page, 1 to 100 (default 20).

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List webhook deliveries
